_README: Append-only ledger: config file -> version -> the SHA-256 that version froze at.
A test reads this file and fails when a config's current hash does not match its
recorded version, or when a version number is reused with a different hash.
NEVER edit or delete an existing entry. To change a config: bump its `version`,
then append the new version and hash here in the same commit.
Hashes are of the raw file bytes: sha256sum config/<file>.

_provenance.observed_note: Computed from the file on disk at 2026-09-03. Verifiable now.
_provenance.reconstructed_note: Taken from SHA-256 values printed during the 2026-09-02/03 working session. The files they describe no longer exist on disk, so these entries CANNOT be re-verified. They are recorded because they are directly observed output, not inference. Treat them as evidence, not as proof.
_provenance.omitted: themes.yaml v1-v2 and modalities.yaml v1-v2 and v5 are deliberately absent. v1-v2 hashes were never printed and cannot be reconstructed with confidence; modalities.yaml never had a v5 (it went 4 -> 6 so the pair would identify one dictionary state). A guessed entry would be worse than a missing one.

_known_version_reuse: Three breaches of the version rule occurred on 2026-09-02/03. Recorded so the
ledger explains rather than hides them.
modalities.yaml v2: content changed under an unchanged version. No single hash
is authoritative for v2, so v2 is omitted entirely.
themes.yaml v7: notes corrected after the run; SHA moved 2acc04f7 -> 015b89fb.
The ledger records v7 = 2acc04f7, the state the run consumed. The corrected
content was then republished as v8.
themes.yaml v8: an interim state 015b89fb existed before the include[5] repair
and was never consumed by a run. The ledger records the final v8 = 5ff6b0a9.
themes.yaml v9: SHA moved c370bcde -> b7781bf2 when the chain-of-thought,
tool-use and PathChat notes were added. The ledger records v9 = c370bcde, the
state the run consumed; the amended content is v10.
